column1: # ir-conform: the cases PCL's own CL target does NOT answer the way perl does.
# The corpus is harvested from the probe files review sessions left behind, so
# it is dense in exactly the places PCL is still wrong -- that is the point of
# it.  Every row here is a PCL BUG with an owning task, never a case edited to
# pass and never a "known difference" without a fix owner.  A row's case still
# RUNS: `tools/ir-conform` prints it as KNOWN and does not fail the run, an
# UNLISTED failure fails the run like a regression, and a listed case that
# starts PASSING is reported STALE and fails the run (the skip-registry's
# Rows leave this file BY EDIT, with the fix, one at a time.

column3: AN ACCIDENTAL PASS UNTIL s484b: line 7 asks the slots AFTER reading @a and %h, so perl answers `ARRAY=def HASH=def` (a read RE-VIVIFIES a cleared slot) and PCL used to answer def because it had not removed them at all.  Shape (B) removes them, so the case now fails honestly on residue (a) -- reads do not re-vivify; NS:`undef *GLOB` leaves an EMPTY aggregate slot where perl REMOVES it

the LAST line only: after `undef *a` and a READ of @a, perl has RE-VIVIFIED the slot and `*a{ARRAY}` is a ref where PCL still answers undef -- residue (a) of #1117's shape (B), NS:`undef *GLOB` leaves an EMPTY aggregate slot where perl REMOVES it.  The four-slot line ABOVE it agrees since s484b (the rows 077/078/092 that covered it left this file then)
warnings-gated diagnostics are absent ("Filehandle $fh opened only for output")

the statement is REFUSED (`local` in a non-leading expression position, "not supported (#3370)"), so the caught text names that refusal where perl names "Can't use an undefined value as an ARRAY reference" -- its location half (#1240) left with s543a
the four `local` nested-element spellings, one row each
utf8::is_utf8 on a byte string answers 1; perl answers 0 -- RULED DIVERGENCE (s473h): PCL has no downgraded form, so 1 is the honest answer for its model
a pipe with a `:utf8` layer on one end: perl dies, PCL reads the line

`for my $x (sort LITERALS) { $x .= "!" }` must die read-only; PCL modifies -- 8 of 18 shapes measured s473h, per ELEMENT and propagating through sort/reverse/grep; needs a marked literal slot, not a box flag.  Second cause: exit 255 vs 0 (#1247)
